title: The Amazon and Chiribiquete: a forest with rock art
goal: Express concession with aun cuando while describing Chiribiquete and the threats to the Colombian Amazon.

items: I can use *aun cuando* with the subjunctive for a possibility and with the indicative for a fact.
I can say what makes Chiribiquete special and what threatens the Amazon.
I can use the new words for mountain range, rock art and deforestation.
